content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Service Discovery and Load Balancing in Docker"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"When scaling applications across multiple containers, managing how they find and communicate with each other becomes a core architectural challenge. This tutorial covers service discovery and load balancing using Docker's built-in features."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Understanding Docker Swarm and Overlay Networks"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Docker Swarm provides native clustering and orchestration. By utilizing an overlay network, containers running on different physical or virtual hosts can securely communicate without exposing ports to the external network."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"docker network create --driver overlay my-overlay-network"},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"Built-in Service Discovery"},{"order":7,"type":"paragraph","text":"Docker Swarm includes an internal DNS server. Every service created within an overlay network is automatically registered with this DNS. Other containers can resolve the service name to an internal IP address dynamically."},{"order":8,"type":"code","text":"docker service create --name web-app --network my-overlay-network --replicas 3 nginx"},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"IPVS-Based Load Balancing"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"Docker automatically distributes incoming requests to a service across all its replica tasks using an internal load balancer based on IP Virtual Server (IPVS) technology. This ensures high availability and even traffic distribution."},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"DNS Round Robin resolves service names to multiple task IPs."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Ingress routing mesh routes traffic entering any node port directly to an active container."},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Verification and Testing"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"To verify that load balancing is functioning properly, you can deploy a utility container and execute recurring curl requests against the service name."},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"docker run --rm --network my-overlay-network alpine/httpie sh -c \"while true; do http web-app; sleep 1; done\""}]
